mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the weather is a clear 55 degrees at Verona Area High School with the moon in its first quarter. The ISS will fly overhead tonight for four minutes starting at 5:42 AM, appearing in the West Southwest over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot. The overnight low will be 42 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15, a school bus driver was arrested for O W I. Officers responded to reports of dangerous driving and found the bus near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace, though thankfully no one was injured.

There is plenty to do this weekend in Verona. We have live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Next week brings trivia nights at Hop Haus, the Bogey Factory, and Paddy Mac's, plus ART House 360 events on Thursday.

Regarding the incident on Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a bus driver for O W I, ruling out alcohol and continuing their investigation into a potential traffic sign collision.
Today's flavor of the day is a refreshing Mint Cookie. Culver's is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:00 PM tonight.
